meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why is my son's essay sitting on your desk with a zero on it?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Go on.

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
Owen drafts on paper and types it in afterward. Plenty of students do. Why isn't that what this is?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Eleven thirty-one, eleven fifty-two, eleven fifty-eight. I've written them down. Whatever happens, Hale, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Maybe it's from another edition, or a critic he read and got wrong. Boys misquote, Hale. Does a wrong quotation make it not his?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Fine. So what does the procedure say happens now?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and the essay, Hale. Isn't that what an outline is for?

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4. In writing tonight, with nothing on his file. He'll do the rewrite to put this behind him, Hale, not because he did anything.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
I'll ask him tonight. Put Thursday the twelfth in the writing, Hale.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Dear Hale,

You agreed to a private, supervised rewrite after school, not in front of his class, before December 1, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. I still expect that confirmed in writing with nothing on his file, and Thursday the twelfth put in it once I have asked Owen. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite to put this behind him, and she still wants it confirmed in writing with nothing on his record and the Thursday date in it; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You told her to search the scene for the line that sounded like Shakespeare and that it was not there, which gave her something she could check herself.
What cost ground: Nothing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history from late on October 28 sat in the same month and close to that hour, though nothing said ties it to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, which is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she suggested another edition or a critic, you answered only the misquote, so ask for the edition or source Owen used and let her bring it.
